column3: Twin islets west of central Key Lento. Look through wreckage beside the blue boat on the beach.
column4: Examine the bottle for note 1/6. Look for purple material over the blue hull.

column3: Long north-south island west of Key Lento. Search its south tip beside the red debris and dark plants.
column4: Examine the bottle for note 2/6. A tipped red bucket is another reported landmark on the long island.

column3: Rocky sandbar west of Key Lento and just north of the curved mangrove island. Search among the exposed rocks.
column4: Examine the bottle for note 3/6. An alternate guide reports a yellow swim fin near exposed roots; compare note number.

column3: Small wedge-shaped sandbar west of northern Key Lento, toward Gambit Bay. Search sand by the plants on its southeast shore.
column4: Examine the bottle for note 4/6. Look for blue-and-yellow beach ball by flat rocks at the waterline.

column3: Small curved island in the eastern Shoeless Keys, north of Gambit Bay and west of the highway. Walk to the northeast beach.
column4: Examine the bottle for note 5/6. Check the toy shovel near the tree-line shadows.

column3: Hook-shaped mangrove island west of Key Lento. Look under the mangroves where sand opens up away from the water.
column4: Examine the bottle for note 6/6. A second map clue points to the east side of the low hill. Look for a pink flying disc by exposed roots.
